units.source_text: 源氏公子到了左大臣邸内，葵姬照例并不立刻出来相见。

en.t: Prince Genji arrived at the Left Minister's residence, but Lady Aoi, as usual, did not come out at once to meet him.

units.source_text: 公子寂寞无聊，只得独自思量种种事情。

en.t: Feeling lonely and bored, the prince could only sit by himself and think over all sorts of things.

units.source_text: 后来取过筝来弹奏，吟唱催马乐《贯川》：“……没有一夜好安眠……”[\[6\]](#part1337.html#m6)

en.t: Later he took up a koto and played it, singing the saibara song Kantsugawa: "... not one night have I slept in peace ..."[\[6\]](#part1337.html#m6)

units.source_text: 左大臣来了，和他谈论前日花宴中的趣事：

en.t: The Left Minister came in and talked with him about the amusing events at the recent flower banquet:

units.source_text: “老夫如许高龄，历仕四朝明主，也算阅历得多了，

en.t: "I am now an old man of such advanced years, and having served four reigns of enlightened sovereigns, I may say I have seen a great deal,

units.source_text: 却从来不曾见过此次那样清新警策的诗文、尽善尽美的舞乐，

en.t: yet never before have I seen poetry and prose as fresh and striking as this, or music and dance brought to such perfection,

units.source_text: 从来不曾感到此次那样陶情适性，却病延年。

en.t: nor have I ever felt anything so soothing to the heart and nature, so able to drive away illness and prolong one's years.

units.source_text: 目今正是文运昌隆、人才辈出之时，加之吾婿精通诸艺，

en.t: These days literary fortune is flourishing and talented people are appearing in abundance; moreover, my son-in-law is accomplished in every art,

units.source_text: 善于调度贤才，故能有此胜绩也。

en.t: and he is skilled at assigning worthy talents to their proper places, which is why such a splendid achievement was possible.

units.source_text: 老夫虽年迈，也有闻鸡起舞之兴呢！”

en.t: Though I am old, even I feel the urge to rise and dance at the first crow of the cock!"
